biotools.summary: askBrassica federates Brassica and canola data resources in one search and a public MCP server: Ensembl Plants genes for B. napus, B. rapa, B. oleracea, B. juncea and Camelina with Arabidopsis orthology and function, the UWA B. napus and B. oleracea pangenomes (gene presence/absence by crop form), resistance gene analogues and loci, BnIR stress expression and GWAS, Expression Atlas RNA-seq, CropSNPdb Brassica 60K genotypes, INRAE GnpIS trials and germplasm (FAIDARE), GBIF genebank accessions and Europe PMC literature, with gene and genome browser views.
